name: Biketerra Universal Logger
description: Rowing/cycling session logger: live graphs, FIT export, Intervals.icu and Strava upload, social follow. Ported from the userscript v8.15.2.

settings.label: Intervals.icu athlete ID
settings.description: Looks like i12345. Intervals.icu > Settings > Developer Settings.

settings.label: Intervals.icu API key
settings.description: Used to read your zones and upload rides. Saved write-only: the page can never read it back.

settings.label: Strava refresh token
settings.description: Needs the activity:write scope. Terra stores the new one whenever Strava hands out a fresh token.

settings.label: Rowing FTP (W), fallback
settings.description: Used for the graph zones until Intervals.icu answers.
